x: Both the juniors, Bob Cooper and Jim Purdy, have been jumping well and show promise. We were not too successful in either the Svard or Kinnaird meetings.

Hunter, Robertson, Bailey and Harry Turner are new members as Seniors and Jim Purdy and Pete Hunt two promising Juniors. We have of course lost some of our Juniors to the Services, but there are a number of new ones to take their places.

Bob Cooper, who won our first Junior High Jump championship, will be a Senior, but Jim Purdy and one or two others show great promise. Whilst mentioning this championship—support for it was very poor.
Jim Purdy was third in the junior high jump and is one that we can always rely on for this event, but we would like to see some more promising young jumpers join our ranks.
Jim Purdy won the High Jump and also gained third place in the Javelin, while Frank Kemp won the Shott Putt and it was a case of everyone having a go at everything !

Bergvalds also set up a new club record in the Discus Throw and again in the Weight and he is a most consistent performer and deserves his successes. Jim Purdy in the junior High Jump set up new figures and Doug.
Jones and Jim Purdy being 2nd and 3rd in the High Jump. Final match points were: Belgrave H., 53; Herne Hill H., 34; Woodford Green A.C., 24.
However, we do appear to have three very promising youngsters in this event, and may have a "Savidge" in our midst! Jim Purdy retained his junior High Jump title with a leap of 5 feet, and E.
